text:
chris: Starting SDK release push for py/ts v1.12.0 in the change window. Will attempt npm + pypi publish, then tag.
aisha: heads up: product asked to pin the old sync-client as deprecated in the changelog and add a migration note.
kevin: quick check: do we have any dependent internal packages that pin to exact 1.11.x? I can run a grep.
chris: I scanned internal manifests last night; two internal examples pin to ~1.11.x (range), not exact. Should be fine.
deploy-bot: publish attempt 1749991300 by chris - npm publish started for @redwood/sdk-ts@1.12.0
deploy-bot: outcome: success (npm)
chris: npm is live. proceeding to pypi.
kevin: reminder: we previously had a case where py whl signed correctly but the package metadata had old version in sdist causing pip to select older wheel in some scenarios. Please verify wheel and sdist.
aisha: good catch. chris, can you upload both wheel and sdist and confirm package index shows 1.12.0 for both artifacts?
chris: uploading now... deploy-bot: publish attempt 1749991500 by chris - pypi upload in progress
deploy-bot: outcome: partial-fail (sdist failed checksum validation), wheel ok
kevin: checksum fail often from bad tarpack step. Option: 1) yank npm and pypi and republish both; 2) reupload sdist only then flip final tag; 3) leave npm and mark py as pending and add a temporary dist-tag. I'd prefer to avoid yank.
aisha: product wants release notes pushed now. We can still ship notes with "python sdist being corrected; wheel available" but that's messy. Better to fix sdist quickly and coordinate tag flip.
release-manager: decision: do not yank npm. Add an ephemeral npm dist-tag "v1.12.0-pending-py" and hold the stable release tag until both artifacts verified.
chris: applying tag: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-ts@1.12.0 v1.12.0-pending-py`
deploy-bot: dist-tag action recorded 1749991620 by chris
chris: fixing sdist locally, repacking with `python -m build` and reuploading to pypi...
deploy-bot: publish attempt 1749991800 by chris - pypi sdist upload outcome: success
kevin: verify checksum: `twine check dist/*` passed for both wheel and sdist. Good.
chris: flipping internal release marker: removing pending tag, adding stable tag timestamp 1749991860
deploy-bot: dist-tag action recorded 1749991860 by chris - v1.12.0 marked stable
docs: drafting release notes now: will include small note "python sdist initially failed checksum; reuploaded within change window; no consumer impact expected" and migration note about legacy sync-client deprecation. PR #612 created.
aisha: please make sure the deprecation blurb has upgrade snippet for both pip and npm and a link to migration guide.
release-manager: follow-up items: audit CI packing steps to prevent sdist churn, add twine check to release pipeline, and add an automated smoke install in the release job that compares versions across languages. I'll add tickets.
chris: final: release published, docs PR opened, no rollback required. Thanks team.
